transformations: original_text = publisher aya_text with ONLY the trailing separator (U+00A0, or U+0020 for 2:286) and the trailing ayah-number glyph removed. The glyph is a font-specific code point that renders as an unrelated ligature without the KFGQPC font; the ayah number is kept in structured fields. The full publisher string is stored verbatim in metadata_json.publisher_aya_text and validation proves exact reconstruction.
normalized_text = normalize_for_search(aya_text_emlaey). aya_text_emlaey is the publisher's own imla'i text 'used for search purpose' (read.me). Never displayed.
original_text_digest_note: sha256 over (id, original_text) of all Quran passages in rowid order, as built in Phase 2 (2026-10-01); checked by scripts/validate_corpus.py
